description: Checks a scene without drawing it. Returns every error with its path and how to fix it, and warnings for things that are valid but probably not intended (angles in radians, shapes outside the image, shapes of different colors passing through each other). A scene is plain JSON: { width, height, rotate?, children: [...] } with shapes such as dot, path, ellipse, rect, polygon, box, pyramid, cylinder, cone and hemisphere placed with translate and rotate (degrees). x is right, y is down, z is toward the viewer. Call get_reference once before writing a first scene. The server remembers the last valid scene: a later call can leave scene out to draw it again, or pass changes to edit it.

scene.description: The scene: an object with width, height and children (JSON text of the same is accepted). Call get_reference for the full format. Leave it out to use the scene from the last valid call.

name: check_scene
title: Check a Zpup scene
